HOW GRANDISON CAN HELP

From a repair to a new room.

Booking a boiler service or repair

For boiler servicing in Glenrothes, give the make, model and previous service date if known. If the appliance is displaying a code or has stopped providing heating or hot water, make a repair enquiry and explain the fault. A maintenance booking should not be assumed to include fault finding.

  • Boiler servicing enquiries →
  • Boiler repairs →
  • Service or repair? →

Planning a replacement and heating changes

For boiler installation, describe your hot-water use, any cylinder and the space around the current appliance. Mention plans to add a shower or alter radiators so these can be considered together. The installation scope needs to reflect the existing system.

  • Boiler installation & replacement →
  • Central heating →
  • Radiators & heated towel rails →

Bathroom and plumbing enquiries are welcome too

A boiler appointment is only one kind of work you can discuss. For a bathroom installation, share room photos, dimensions and the layout you want. For plumbing repairs or replacement fittings, describe the problem and send details of any products you have selected.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Service, fault or replacement?

For routine servicing, share the appliance details and the date of the last service if you know it. For a fault, add the displayed code and whether heating, hot water or both are affected. For a replacement, explain what is prompting the change and how the household uses hot water.

  • Include the boiler make and model.
  • Say whether it is currently working.
  • Ask about availability and the scope of the visit.

Include your postcode and preferred timing. Confirm the agreed work, who supplies the fittings and any preparation or finishing tasks before booking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Can I book servicing if the boiler has a fault?

Explain the fault first. Connor can discuss whether the enquiry needs a repair or fault-finding visit rather than routine servicing.

Do you take enquiries from Markinch and Leslie?

Yes, alongside Glenrothes and other Fife communities. Include the full postcode so location and availability can be checked.

What if I do not know which boiler I have?

A clear photograph of the appliance and any visible make or model information can help the initial enquiry. Do not remove the casing to find information.
